name: Josselin Feist
description: Josselin Feist is a blockchain security researcher with over a decade of experience in software security. He is the creator of Slither, the Solidity static analysis framework, and previously served as Engineering Director of the Blockchain team at Trail of Bits. He holds a PhD in program analysis for security. His work spans DeFi protocols, smart contracts, L1/L2 systems, and core blockchain infrastructure, with a focus on systemic risks, protocol design, and security strategy. He currently works on protocol security at Aave.
